name: the-frost-hides-with-the-panel
description: The frost read as a layer of its own, separate from the panel above it. Same fixture, reveal and region as a sibling scenario: 64px black type under the panel's position, plus the window's own top-left corner pixels the panel's rounded mask excludes. Two things are measured: the frost must not paint past the panel's own rounded corner (mutation-confirmed: a plain square frost lights that corner up to 217-227 against a 99-141 baseline), and once the panel is gone the type must read dark again rather than staying hidden behind a frost nothing is telling to leave. No first-reveal opacity gate: first-reveal-probe.json found every reachable frame already fully settled, even chained directly off the triggering move with no wait_vlog or settle - a reveal has no debounce ahead of its 240ms animation the way a dismiss does, so that fix rests on code review, not a measurement this harness can make.

actions.note: first paint, and the sidebar announces itself

actions.note: The space's own tab is cold at launch, so the row has to be pressed for the pattern to paint in the MAIN window.

actions.note: The row's own Hide button, not Cmd+S -.

the type with no panel over it - the dark baseline the hidden panel must read back to, and the corner's own unfrosted color

actions.note: the gate: the panel is genuinely up before anything is read off it
the slide finishes, so this reads a settled panel, not a moving one
the control: the panel (and its frost) really do cover the type while shown, and this is where the corner is read too

shrink while the panel is shown - a grow past the VM's 768-tall screen clamps silently (frost-survives-tab-switch-shadow-resize). OnWidgetBoundsChanged fires ApplyBounds/SetFrame on the parent's resize (atrium_sidebar_overlay_widget.mm)
the resize commit and its ApplyBounds/SetFrame calls land
the panel is still shown, now at a resized width - the frost must still be there

generous margin past the 240ms slide and the debounce that led into it - a steady-state read, not a race against FinishHide's own completion timing (the harness's own per-action SSH dispatch latency runs several times the slide's own duration, which a scenario this coarse-grained cannot resolve below - see the report's not-verified list)
once everything has settled, is the frost actually gone

assertions.label: the-type-is-under-the-panel
assertions.desc: the control, unchanged from a sibling scenario: with nothing over it, this region reads dark

assertions.label: the-panel-hides-the-type
assertions.desc: the control: the panel (with its frost) genuinely covers the type while showing. MEASURED 2026-09-11: 98.3/114.0/128.3 var 110 against var 10709 for the bare type. The band is a sibling scenario's: the panel now paints the window's own oceanBlue backdrop natively under the page, where the old page-drawn wash read the untinted literal (207/211/216) and never followed the space.

assertions.label: the-frost-is-still-there-1-2s-after-the-reveal
assertions.desc: THE PRESENCE MEASUREMENT, sampled by panel-over-page's own 2000ms settle after the reveal vlog. The wash alone (no blur) reduces variance only by its own alpha squared - at the panel's live ~.55 Glass opacity that is about 20% of the page-alone baseline, not under 10%. A frost that fades in and then vanishes once its reveal animation completes reads in that 20% band, not this one.

assertions.label: the-frost-survives-a-live-resize-while-shown
assertions.desc: SetFrame runs on every ApplyBounds call the width drag triggers. A fade held only by an animation SetFrame removes drops to model 0 here even though the panel never dismissed.

assertions.label: the-frost-does-not-bleed-past-the-panels-corner
assertions.desc: THE SHAPE MEASUREMENT. This 6x6 patch sits outside the panel's own OverlayCornerRadius() curve (18px, at the window's top-left), which the panel's content.layer already masks away - the page's own dark chrome (99,127,141) should show straight through. Mutation-confirmed: a frost given no corner mask of its own lights this same patch to (217,224,227), a plain rectangle showing behind the panel's rounded corner exactly as reported.

assertions.label: the-frost-is-gone-once-the-panel-is
assertions.desc: steady-state: once the panel has dismissed, the frost is not left behind covering the type on its own
